patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-quality photography and video dominate sections, often serving as backgrounds for minimal text overlays.
A sophisticated sans-serif is used for prominent headings and navigation, contrasted with a classic, elegant serif for body text, creating an editorial and refined feel.
A stark monochrome palette of black, white, and various shades of grey is consistently used, with a single vibrant blue reserved for interactive elements and subtle accents.
The header dynamically transforms from a transparent, full-logo state to a compact, opaque 'FG' logo with a solid background and subtle shadow upon scroll.
Content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth, guided scrolling experience.
Immersive, full-width hero sections featuring high-production video or photography are used to establish mood and brand identity, followed by more structured content blocks.

technique_notes: The site employs a dynamic header that transitions from an initial transparent, full-logo state to a smaller, opaque version with an abbreviated logo and a subtle drop shadow once the user scrolls past the initial hero content.
Content sections are introduced with a scroll-triggered animation, where elements subtly fade into view and slide upwards as they become visible within the viewport, enhancing engagement.
A full-screen, silent video serves as the hero background, creating an immersive and atmospheric introduction to the site, with key messaging overlaid for legibility.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant sans-serif headings (approx. 2-3x body text) paired with a refined serif for body copy and smaller sans-serif for navigation and labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and spacious, especially in hero sections and between major content blocks, creating a sense of luxury and calm.

standout: The site stands out with its sophisticated, editorial aesthetic achieved through the dominant use of large, high-quality, mood-setting photography and video. The minimal text and generous white space allow the visuals to convey the brand's luxury and design-focused approach, creating an immersive and aspirational experience rather than a purely informational one.
